Detailed Description

A rod pose: node displacements and element frame axes.

Values are expressed in the model frame of RodActorPrefab::shapeFile, the same frame as its node positions and rest frame axes. The model transform baked into the shape (RodActorPrefab::scale, RodActorPrefab::shapeRotation, and the effective prefab scale) is applied to the pose too: displacements like node positions, and frame axes like the rest frame axes (by the inverse transpose, then renormalized). RodActorPrefab::shapeTranslation does not affect them. When RodActorPrefab::shapeFile is empty (a preset RodActorParams::shape), the pose is applied unchanged.

See also
Actor::GetRodPose, Actor::SetRodPose

◆ elementFrameAxes

DynamicArray<real> superdex::prefab::RodPose::elementFrameAxes {}

Element frame axes, flattened as [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, ...].

Must contain 3 finite values per element. After the model transform is applied, each axis is expected to be a unit vector orthogonal to its deformed element, within a tolerance of 1e-3. Geometry violations emit warnings; the supplied pose is still applied.
